**Describe the feature request**

This is the corresponding issue for existing PR: https://github.com/istio/istio/pull/53367

Allows users to put extra white spaces between namespaces in `networking.istio.io/exportTo` annotation.

Currently, adding extra white spaces between namespaces in `networking.istio.io/exportTo` annotation causes unexpected behavior. For example, `networking.istio.io/exportTo: ns1, ns2` is re…

result it's not exported to `ns2` namespace properly.

None.
